items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot materials establish API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms point against the proposed public/commercial use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional where it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Technical compliance is not legal certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown. Open findings include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Analytics is yellow because some source permissions or collectors fail; revenue is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero, but do not clear launches or claims that depend on unavailable evidence.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or new queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by the existing deadline.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because direct evidence is still missing. Existing progress is limited to official source review, partial repository/configuration flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.
